# About this notebook {.unnumbered}

This is the running record of SSBMF progress, one chapter per advisor
meeting. Each chapter covers what changed in the method, what was run to
validate it (on real cohorts and on simulation), whether the new results
make sense, and what's still open. Figures and tables that came up in
discussion are included directly; anything that needs the full statistical
detail is linked out under that chapter's "Deep dive."

For a complete session-by-session build log (every script, test, and
decision), see `PROJECT_STATUS.qmd` at the repo root. This notebook is the
meeting-facing summary, not a replacement for that log.

Chapters are listed in the sidebar in date order — click a date to jump
straight to that meeting.
